//UnderworldDoor: Feature 30 (plan section 30, pack Prompt 43): the SOFT ROW. Forest Lore's Ancient Cairn (a CardType 2 site card) gets the same door to the Underworld as Harsh Wilds' own Stone Cairn (hw_cairn): one extra DismantleAction, offered at night, that drops only hwenvunderworld. GameSourceModify patches the card in place when Forest Lore is installed; with it absent the framework lists fl_ancient_cairn as one unresolved reference and nothing is added. The action is appended as a whole object (DismantleActionsWarpData, WarpType 4), after the cairn's own two actions, so Forest Lore's actions are untouched.

ActionDescription.DefaultText: At night, go down the old stair into the Underworld. You can stay a few hours at most: climb back whenever you like, and when the grey light fails the stair carries you up to this tomb.

FadeMessage.DefaultText: You go down the old stair...
